@@U02974@@
This is the noblest mission of the young! The world was not, until I gave it being. I urged the sun to rise out of the sea. It was I who set the moon on its changing course. As I passed by the earth put on its finest, grew green and blossomed to meet me. At my sign, the stars in all their splendor spread out in the heavens on that first night. Who but I delivered you from the narrow, literal-minded philistine? But I’m free, free as the voice inside me, and joyous to be so, to follow my inner light and move as swiftly as thought can carry me, day before me, and behind me night.

@@U02975@@
(Exit.)

@@U02977@@
Off you go in your glory, then! What an original! How it would wound him to know that nothing wise or foolish can be thought that wasn't thought many ages ago. But there’s no harm in the boy. Times change, things change; a few years and all will be different. However absurdly the grape juice foams and sputters, in the end it turns into some sort of wine.

@@U02978@@
(To the younger members of the audience who fail to applaud.)

@@U02979@@
I see my words leave you cold, my dears, but that’s quite all right; just remember, the Devil’s old; when you're older, you'll know what he’s about.
translation:
@@U02974@@
这是年轻人最崇高的使命！世界并不存在，直到我创造了它。我催促太阳从海里升起。是我让月亮改变了轨迹。当我经过时，大地披上了最美的色彩，绿油油的，鲜花盛开迎接我。在我的星座，第一个夜晚，繁星在天空中绽放出绚丽的光芒。除了我之外，谁能把你从狭隘的、只注重字面意义的市侩中拯救出来呢？但我是自由的，就像我内心的声音一样自由，而且很高兴能够如此，跟随我内心的光芒，以思想所能携带的最快速度移动，白天在我之前，在我后面黑夜。

@@U02975@@
（退出。）

@@U02977@@
那么，就带着你的荣耀出发吧！多么原创啊！如果他知道许多年前没有想到的任何明智或愚蠢的想法都会让他感到多么痛苦。但男孩并没有什么坏处。时代变了，事情变了；几年后，一切都会不同。无论葡萄汁如何起泡、溅射，最终它都会变成某种葡萄酒。

@@U02978@@
（致未能鼓掌的年轻观众。）

@@U02979@@
我发现我的话让你感到冷淡，亲爱的，但没关系；请记住，魔鬼已经老了；等你长大了，你就会知道他是怎么回事。
